description: Suggest a follow-up task for the owner to approve. The suggestion is staged and shown to the owner as an approval card in this chat (Approve-once / Deny, owner-only); on approval the follow-up starts as its own agent run with the suggested prompt. If the owner does not answer within the approval window the suggestion stays pending — re-present it or dismiss it with dismiss_task. In autonomous mode the suggestion auto-runs with no card and no approval. Title at most 60 characters, prompt at most 32 KB. Returns the task_id and the outcome (pending / approved / started / denied).
name: suggest_task

prompt.description: The full prompt the follow-up run starts with (at most 32 KB).

title.description: Short title for the follow-up (at most 60 characters). Shown on the approval card.

tldr.description: One-line summary shown on the approval card; defaults to the start of the prompt.
